A couple of kids from my high school got into Yale - a Latino girl and a White girl. The Latino student was the class president, an honor roll student, and had multiple letters of recommendation, whereas the selection of the White student came as a bit of a surprise. Who was likely selected on merit alone?
A. Not known
B. The White student
C. The Latino student
